brief.description: Mineral blend visibly enriched with yellow sulfur
brief.purpose: Distinct readable frontier supply in the shared resource family.
brief.silhouette: Same four-stone clay mound as ordinary blend, with several large sulfur pieces among the clay
brief.materials: One compact low mound of coarse mineral blend: four or five large irregular dull gray gravel chunks embedded in muted clay-brown crumbs. Angular stones, earthy binder, a few subordinate lighter mineral chips. Readable broad clumps, not dozens of tiny grains. No container or bag, no yellow sulfur, no metallic shine. Slight three-quarter top view.
brief.interfaces: Existing item identity, recipe and stack behavior unchanged.
brief.construction: Generated high-resolution master reduced by shared alpha-safe sprite pipeline.
brief.invariants: Art only; no container cost or new gameplay mechanics.
brief.material_behavior: Broad material-specific clusters, subordinate marks, restrained saturation.
brief.signature_feature: Broad ochre-yellow sulfur chips between gray stones
brief.neighboring_assets: Cloth, sulfur, Machine Parts and the other frontier supplies.
fidelity_targets: Preserve ordinary blend mound and stone positions

references.role: Shape and material invariant; enrich this exact blend.
Sulfur color and fracture reference only.

generations.prompt: Edit reference 1 into sulfur-enriched mineral blend. Preserve its overall silhouette, four gray stones, clay-brown binder, camera, coarse stepped pixel-art style and upper-left lighting. Add three or four broad angular yellow sulfur chips nestled visibly between the gray stones, replacing some clay regions and pale small chips; yellow should occupy roughly one fifth of the mound and remain clearly visible in a tiny inventory icon. Use reference 2 ONLY for sulfur yellow color and fractured material character. Keep the stones gray, do not recolor the entire mound. High-resolution master composed of broad connected pixel clusters, no subpixel grains, no new container, labels or glow. Same generous transparent margin and true transparent background.
